verified_documentary_cases.fact: Orange-room recollection;reported yesterday or two days earlier.
Character/fear recollection with uncertain dream attribution.
Hospital imagery;retain authors category despite contextual words.

category_definitions.definition: Specific prior-dream recollection with temporal context.
Dream-associated elements without a specific dated dream.
Dream-like current feeling or consciousness state.

category_precedence: Explicit uncertainty or conflicting declarations -> review_required. Specific recollection with denied dream association; temporal context with denied specific recollection; recalled dream mixed with present dreamy-state -> conflicting.
Specific recollection,dream association and specific temporal context,without present dreamy-state -> episodic_like_compatible.
Dream-associated familiarity without specific recollection,present dreamy-state or specific temporal context -> familiarity_like_compatible.
Present dreamy-state without specific recollection or familiarity -> dreamy_state_compatible;not remembered prior dream.
Generic familiarity with denied dream association and no prior recollection or dreamy-state -> unsupported.
All other incomplete combinations -> unclassifiable. Temporal vague/unknown with specific recollection remains unclassifiable.
human_guidance: Conservative compatibility policy,not authors clinical consensus algorithm. Raw narrative is never parsed for category inference. Proposal preserved independently;disagreement exposed. Confidence never supplies missing evidence.
immutable_originals: Canonical SHA256 commits original metadata and exact UTF8 narrative hash;append-only narrative amendments retain original plus parent/version,time,reason and knowledge. Comparison identifies exact original/amended version;later details never inherit original chronology.
chronology: Timezone-aware closed intervals;compare every original lock separately to experience,first report,event. Identical point boundary only -> equal;touching non-point interval -> ambiguous. Invalid reversed interval rejects. Missing original version rejects;missing original first/lock -> unknown;lock before original first or occurrence after first -> conflicting evidence. Hashes are not clocks.
candidate_policy: Finite manifest frozen before manual comparison;every candidate,attempt,nonmatch,unreviewed,excluded,missing-original and unscorable included. Final declaration per candidate uses chronological append order. Later searches have separate post-hoc ledgers/denominators. No semantic retrieval/ranking.
event_policy: Occurrence distinct from publication/discovery and current experience/report;external evidence reference/hash retained as declarations,without external byte or clock authentication. No prediction inferred.
privacy: Local pseudonymous private records. Consent/local processing and rights required;export unsupported in v1. CLI stdout/private JSON includes raw text and must remain private. Reference has no participant data.
rights: CC BY-NC-ND4.0 article; Elsevier proof/publication relationship retained. Facts-only original notes and locators;no PDF,figures,interview corpus or clinical dataset distributed.
dunne_boundary: 1927 ranked scan metadata only/body uninspected. Later Faber/FadedPage witness includes1939 publication history and1934 third-edition additions;ChapterX/AppendixIII recording practice only. No serial-time or prophetic rules transferred.
